nah_002: You can recognise it by its trunk, split into twelve separate stems poured over the limestone rock. It stands in the Amaku green space, beside the Hiranaka spring.
nah_003: You can recognise it by its trunk, rising almost straight before spreading into a full canopy, the only large tree for streets around. It stands on the street beside Jogaku primary school.
nah_004: You can recognise it by its several stems dividing from the base into a rounded crown, with few of the hanging roots gajumaru usually have. It stands in the forecourt of the Takara utaki, inside Takara Park.
nah_005: You can recognise it as the large tree standing over the old village well. It stands on community ground in Uchima, looked after by the Uchima community association.
nah_006: You can recognise it by its branches, spreading out in a flat fan that throws a very wide, very low shade. It stands on the roadside of the national highway in Tomari.
